scientific_integrity: Finite regression checks supplement, but do not establish, the analytic theorem; the literature comparison establishes only best-knowledge novelty, not publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted star Laplacians; one iid Rademacher probe; fixed positive shift; exact arithmetic. The limiting two-node trace variance is nonzero. Specialized earlier results may imply the explicit identity or limiting law.
title: A hub-induced one-step Lanczos bias and an exact chi-square two-step error law
